jobs.title: Product Manager
jobs.description:
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Product Strategy & Roadmap

 - Define, prioritize, and drive the product roadmap for inference and training infrastructure.

 - Stay ahead of AI trends, including new model architectures, hardware optimizations, and open-source developments.

 - Balance qualitative insights (partner feedback, community discussions) with quantitative metrics (benchmarks, system performance) to inform roadmap decisions.

 - Collaborate closely with research and engineering teams, participating in design reviews and technical discussions to evaluate trade-offs.

 - Translate complex technical capabilities into clear user stories, product requirements, and actionable deliverables.

 - Act as a trusted partner to engineering teams, removing blockers by clarifying requirements and managing scope.

User Engagement & Growth

 - Serve as the main point of contact for early adopters and partners, gathering feedback to guide product iterations.

 - Support Go-to-Market initiatives, including creating technical content (blogs, documentation, social assets) and engaging with developer communities.

 - Use data and user research to validate hypotheses and measure the impact of product launches.


QUALIFICATIONS

Minimum Requirements

 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

 - 3+ years of experience in Product Management or a related technical role (Engineering, Solutions Architecture) in a software company.

 - Strong technical fluency in AI/ML infrastructure; comfortable discussing system architecture and reading technical documentation.

 - Excellent communication skills, able to clearly explain complex technical concepts to technical and non-technical stakeholders.

Preferred (Bonus) Qualifications

 - Hands-on coding skills (Python, C++ etc); experience contributing to open-source communities.

 - Experience creating content for developer audiences (blogs, social media) or organizing tech events/hackathons.

 - Data-driven mindset with experience using analytics to drive product decisions.

 - Experience conducting user research and interviews to uncover user pain points.

 - B2B or developer-facing product experience.

 


BENEFITS

 - Competitive salary and equity package.

 - Work with a world-class team from xAI, Google, and leading research labs.

 - Directly impact the future of open AI infrastructure.


ABOUT RADIXARK

RadixArk is an infrastructure-first company built by engineers who've shipped production AI systems, created SGLang (30K+ GitHub stars, the fastest open LLM serving engine), and developed Miles (our large-scale RL framework). Founded by AI infrastructure veterans from xAI and NVIDIA, we're on a mission to democratize frontier-level AI infrastructure by building world-class open systems for inference and training. Our team has optimized kernels serving billions of tokens daily, designed distributed training systems coordinating 10,000+ GPUs, and contributed to infrastructure that powers leading AI companies and research labs.


COMPENSATION

Depending on background, skills, and experience, the expected annual salary range for this position is $160,000 - $300,000 USD + equity.


EQUAL OPPORTUNITY

RadixArk is an Equal Opportunity Employer and is proud to offer equal employment opportunity to everyone regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, citizenship, marital status, disability, gender identity, veteran status, and more.

jobs.title: Technical Program Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

As a Technical Program Manager at RadixArk, you'll drive the execution of complex, cross-functional programs across our inference and training infrastructure. You'll partner closely with Product Management, Research, and Engineering to turn ambitious technical roadmaps into shipped reality, coordinating across kernel teams, distributed systems engineers, and external partners to deliver infrastructure that serves billions of tokens daily and coordinates 10,000+ GPU training runs.

This role is for someone who thrives at the intersection of deep technical understanding and rigorous program execution. You'll own the "how" and "when" of our most critical initiatives.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

Program Execution & Delivery

 - Drive end-to-end execution of large-scale, cross-functional programs spanning inference engines (e.g., SGLang), training frameworks (e.g., Miles), and hardware integration efforts.

 - Define program structure, including milestones, dependencies, critical paths, risks, and success criteria. Maintain a clear source of truth for status across all stakeholders.

 - Run design reviews, sprint planning, release readiness reviews, and post-mortems. Ensure decisions are documented and follow-ups are closed out.

 - Identify and unblock cross-team dependencies across kernel, runtime, scheduler, networking, and model teams before they become release blockers.

 - Drive release management for major versions, including changelog ownership, compatibility validation, partner rollout sequencing, and rollback planning.

Technical Coordination

 - Partner with Product Management to translate roadmap priorities into executable program plans, with clear scope, staffing, and timelines.

 - Work shoulder-to-shoulder with engineering leads on technical trade-off decisions; understand the architecture deeply enough to ask the right questions and surface hidden risks.

 - Coordinate hardware enablement programs with partners like Nvidia, Google, and AWS, including new accelerator bring-up, kernel co-development, and benchmark validation.

 - Manage integration programs with frontier AI labs and early adopters, ensuring technical requirements, SLAs, and feedback loops are well-defined.

Operational Excellence

 - Build and improve the engineering operating cadence, including standups, planning rituals, OKR tracking, dashboards, and reporting to leadership.

 - Establish metrics and instrumentation for program health such as velocity, defect rates, benchmark regressions, and customer-reported issues, and drive accountability against them.

 - Lead incident response coordination for production issues affecting partners; own root-cause review and corrective-action tracking.

 - Improve developer productivity by identifying and removing systemic friction in our build, test, and release pipelines.

Stakeholder Communication

 - Serve as the connective tissue between engineering, product, GTM, and external partners, ensuring everyone has the right information at the right altitude.

 - Produce clear, concise written updates for leadership and partners. Translate engineering progress into business-relevant signals.

 - Represent program status honestly, including risks and slips, with concrete mitigation plans.


QUALIFICATIONS

Minimum Requirements

 - Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

 - 4+ years of direct experience in Technical Program Management, Engineering Management, or a senior engineering role with significant program ownership, in a software or infrastructure company.

 - Strong technical fluency in systems software, distributed systems, or AI/ML infrastructure; able to read code, follow architecture discussions, and challenge technical assumptions productively.

 - Demonstrated track record shipping complex, multi-team programs on time, including managing dependencies, risks, and scope changes.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills; able to drive alignment across engineers, executives, and external partners.

Preferred (Bonus) Qualifications

 - Direct experience shipping AI/ML infrastructure such as inference engines, training frameworks, GPU kernels, distributed schedulers, or model serving platforms.

 - Hands-on coding background (Python, C++, CUDA) and comfort working in engineering codebases, including reading PRs, running benchmarks, and reproducing issues.

 - Experience coordinating with hardware vendors (Nvidia, AMD, Google TPU, AWS Trainium/Inferentia) on enablement or co-engineering programs.

 - Experience driving open-source release programs or working in OSS communities, including issue triage, RFC processes, and contributor coordination.

 - Familiarity with release engineering, CI/CD systems, and observability tooling for large-scale distributed systems.

 - Experience supporting B2B or developer-facing products with enterprise SLAs.


ABOUT RADIXARK

RadixArk is an infrastructure-first company built by engineers who've shipped production AI systems, created SGLang (30K+ GitHub stars, the fastest open LLM serving engine), and developed Miles (our large-scale RL framework). Founded by AI infrastructure veterans from xAI and NVIDIA, we're on a mission to democratize frontier-level AI infrastructure by building world-class open systems for inference and training. Our team has optimized kernels serving billions of tokens daily, designed distributed training systems coordinating 10,000+ GPUs, and contributed to infrastructure that powers leading AI companies and research labs.


COMPENSATION

jobs.title: Product Marketing Manager
jobs.description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

RadixArk is seeking a Product Marketing Manager to own how SGLang, Miles, and our open source infrastructure are positioned and perceived across the market. SGLang already has 20K+ GitHub stars and serves billions of tokens daily across leading AI companies and research labs, and we're looking for someone to be the bridge between our engineering team and the people who decide to adopt, partner with, and write about us.

You'll define our product messaging, drive our launch calendar, and translate deeply technical systems into value that developers, partners, and buyers understand. You'll also bring that messaging to life in person by running our field events, and you'll be the steady hand who shapes our external response when something needs a clear public voice. This role combines product marketing depth with hands-on execution, and you'll have real influence over how our products are positioned and adopted across the AI infrastructure community.


KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

 - Product Positioning & Messaging: Own product positioning and messaging for SGLang, Miles, and the broader platform. Build and maintain buyer personas and ideal customer profiles to guide segmentation and storytelling. Translate complex technical capabilities such as inference optimization and RL post-training into clear, differentiated value for distinct audiences. Partner with engineering and product to turn new releases and features into market-ready narrative as soon as they ship.

 - Go-to-Market & Launches: Own the go-to-market strategy and launch calendar for new products and major updates, coordinating the cross-functional work needed to land them. Produce sales and partner enablement assets including pitch decks, battlecards, case studies, and benchmark narratives. Ensure consistent messaging across every touchpoint, from website and social to partner co-marketing and events.

 - Field Events & Activations: Plan and execute RadixArk's field programs end to end, including developer meetups, partner activations, and industry conference presence. Own agenda, speakers, vendors, on-site execution, and post-event follow-up, not just the brief. Because the messaging originates with you, you keep the content and the experience aligned, and you tie each program back to community growth, adoption, and pipeline.

 - External Communications & Issue Response: Shape RadixArk's external voice across announcements, statements, and executive-facing narrative. Build relationships with media, analysts, and technical influencers. When sensitive situations arise, such as a partner omitting our contribution from their messaging, a contested benchmark, or a community controversy, assess quickly whether and how to respond, set the right framing and channel, and write the response yourself.


QUALIFICATIONS


MINIMUM REQUIREMENTS

 - 5+ years of product marketing experience, ideally in AI infrastructure, developer tools, cloud, or open source.

 - A proven track record translating complex technical products into business-oriented messaging for developers, partners, and buyers.

 - Demonstrated ownership of product launches and go-to-market plans with measurable awareness, adoption, or pipeline impact.

 - Hands-on field event experience, with the ability to run a meetup, summit, or conference presence yourself rather than only directing an agency.

 - Outstanding writing and editorial judgment across positioning, long-form content, and short-form public statements.

 - Sound judgment and composure in sensitive external situations, with the ability to draft clear public-facing responses under time pressure.

 - Self-starter who can identify opportunities and drive initiatives independently with minimal oversight.


PREFERRED (BONUS) QUALIFICATIONS

 - Solid understanding of AI/ML infrastructure, including LLM serving, distributed training, and GPU optimization.

 - Experience working with or marketing a popular open source AI/ML project.

 - Existing relationships with media, analysts, or technical influencers in the AI infrastructure space.

 - Experience building or scaling a product marketing function, with the appetite to grow into a team lead.

 - Bilingual in Chinese and English, comfortable aligning internally in Chinese and producing external content in English.

 - Active presence in developer or AI communities such as GitHub, Twitter/X, Discord, or Reddit.
